SELECT s.symbol, s.sector, s.date_issued, s.target_1, s.target_2, s.stop_loss, s.price_at_issue, s.price_at_resolution, 
s.hit_target, s.hit_stop, e.close
FROM signals.signal_log s
JOIN market.equity_eod e ON s.symbol = e.symbol
WHERE s.date_issued >= (SELECT MAX(date_issued) - INTERVAL '20 days' FROM signals.signal_log)
AND e.trade_date = s.date_resolved;

title: Signal Outcome Feedback Review Variant 1537

python_tool.code:
def run(context):
    signals = context['signals']
    success = sum(1 for signal in signals if signal['hit_target'])
    failure = sum(1 for signal in signals if signal['hit_stop'])
    total = len(signals)
    success_rate = success / total if total > 0 else 0
    failure_rate = failure / total if total > 0 else 0
    return {'success_rate': success_rate, 'failure_rate': failure_rate}

WITH recent_vcp AS (
    SELECT 
        s2vp.symbol, 
        s2vp.vcp_score, 
        s2vp.enhanced_fund_score,
        s2vp.price,
        se.mh.trade_date
    FROM 
        scores.stage2_vcp_picks s2vp

        AND se.trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    ORDER BY

)
